results.snippet: The SaaS was an all in one platform for writing Blogs, Newsletters, Building Email Lists, and also had a Link-In-Bio page, lol. Over-ambitiously I was trying to compete with a sea of established players like WordPress, Beehiiv, ConvertKit, Substack, Linktree…without any damn USP.

results.title: <![CDATA[The SaaS Playbook ]]>
results.snippet: Ever increasing valuations driven by growth made profitability an afterthought for startups, and debt unnecessary. Clearly, we are in a different place today, but some companies in need of capital are reluctant to swallow down rounds, instead taking convertible notes which kick the valuation can down the road.
